longDescription:
sysinfo is a graphical tool that is able to display some hardware and software information about the computer it is run on.

It is able to recognize information about: - System (Linux distribution release, versions of GNOME, kernel, gcc and Xorg and hostname); - CPU (vendor identification, model name, frequency, level2 cache, bogomips, model numbers and flags); - Memory (total system RAM, free memory, swap space total and free, cached, active, inactive memory); - Storage (IDE interface, all IDE devices, SCSI devices); - Hardware (motherboard, graphic card, sound card, network devices); - NVIDIA graphic card: only with NVIDIA display driver installed.
